⚽️⚽️⚽️Easy Play ! ⚽️⚽️⚽️
【🌈Rainbow Flick】：↑ + Ability Button
【⚡Flash Dribbling】：←/→ + Ability Button
【🌀Marseille Turn】：↓ + Ability Button
【🤸Bicycle Kick】：Shot Button (During the Rainbow Flick)

Without any extra buttons! You can experience a whole football match.

You can play as a forward, defender, or goalkeeper.
